title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
description: About Smartnumbers We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams. What you'll be working on We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: Build and maintain a 12– 18 month active pipeline to support business objectives Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline What you’ll achieve You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. The types of areas you’ll look at include: New Business Development Leading client facing discover conversations to establish key business issues Understanding and navigating the different approaches to fraud prevention across different sectors Helping Clients build business cases for Smartnumbers adoption Sharing intelligence and best practice across organisations Increasing market awareness by supporting events, posts or other GTM activities Building trust and a network of advocates among your client base How you’ll work You’ll be part of an empowered cross functional go to market team that leverages best practice and seeks continual improvement. You’ll be given the freedom to manage your own time with support and guidance from senior sales leadership. You’ll be expected to build, maintain and report on a clear 12–18 month runway of pipeline with dedicated time set aside each week for strategic focus and execution on new business development. What you'll need for the role Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience: Numbers Obsessed – You live and breathe your pipeline and progress and take pride in its resilience and accuracy. Curious - You want to understand the problems our customers face and how we might solve them. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc. Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO What we can offer you As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include: Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!) Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown Life insurance of 4 x your salary Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year. The application process We have a simple 3 stage application process: 30-minute phone call with the hiring manager 1 hour interview and presentation HR and Bar Raiser Interview Smartnumbers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, neurodiversity, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. title: General Counsel (Office based)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based in our office in London, UK.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more. Our Team Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph , BBC and the New Statesman . Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million. We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology. This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. title: Account Executive - [UK&I]
description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As Vanta continues to grow, winning in the International markets will be critical. We’re just starting to establish our EMEA presence, and we need talented and customer focused Account Executives who are excited to help build and grow a large and untapped UK&I markets as we continue to distinguish Vanta as best-in-class to prospects in a burgeoning competitive landscape. If this sounds like you, and you’re excited to be a part of our founding sales team in EMEA, we'd love to hear from you. What you’ll do as an Account Executive at Vanta: Own your pipeline from the ground up — identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, building a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities. Run a world-class sales process — qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar structured methodology to drive predictable outcomes. Convert interest into long-term value — educate prospects on the business impact of Vanta, deliver compelling demos, and tailor solution recommendations to each customer’s goals. Communicate with executive presence — engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex compliance and security concepts into clear business value. Continuously sharpen your craft — act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to improving team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices. Be a self-starter who makes things happen — operate with urgency, ownership, and autonomy in a fast-moving environment where results matter. Champion market expansion — explore partnership opportunities, represent Vanta at industry events, and help us deepen our presence in new and existing markets. Cross-Functional — working alongside our SDR team, marketing team, legal and Solutions Engineers to find, run and win deals. How to be successful in this role: 3+ years closing experience Have had a closing and quota-carrying role in the past, while consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets Be experienced in B2B SaaS, preferably in SMB and Mid-Market Be highly curious, seeking to understand customers, their needs and how best Vanta can help them Possess the technical competency to understand Vanta’s software and build great relationships with highly technical prospects Have stellar problem-solving skills, and an enthusiasm for making a large impact early on at a start-up Have entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and autonomy so you can make a huge contribution to the EMEA landing team Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£60,000 - £65,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!</p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help embed our software capitalisation process working closely with our engineering and business teams to create an automated and scalable solution.</li> <li>Take on the role of product owner for the financial reporting processes of software capitalisation, operating key controls across month end close and performing impairment assessments.</li> <li>Use your strong technical knowledge of relevant IFRS standards for capitalisation and impairment to support and challenge the business on areas of judgement and documentary evidence.</li> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£60,000 - £65,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. HEALTHCARE: Health and dental insurance. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. title: Senior Director Global, BI Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit  <a href="../5377643008/wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.</p> <p>Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.</p> <p>OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.</p> <p>The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.</p> <p>OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.</p> <p>By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.</p> <p><strong>Sr. Director, Business Intelligence</strong></p> <p>In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. </p> <p>Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. </p> <p>Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.</p> <ul> <li>Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption</li> <li>Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers</li> <li>Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation</li> <li>Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop</li> <li>Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)</li> <li>Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work</li> <li>Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data</li> <li>Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals</li> <li>Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of title: Senior UX Researcher (f/m/d)
description: <p></p> <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong></p> <p>Are you passionate about uncovering meaningful user insights and influencing product decisions through evidence-based research? We're looking for a Senior UX Researcher to lead strategic and tactical research initiatives across our platform, helping teams better understand our customers and make informed decisions with confidence. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Data, and other customer facing teams to plan and deliver impactful research. You'll be comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and driving research projects forward from inception to outcome with minimal oversight. Our team is a group of collaborative, curious, and dedicated people who care deeply about creating great experiences for our customers. Alongside meaningful work, we offer a supportive environment and a range of excellent benefits.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be responsible for</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading end-to-end research projects, from problem definition and scoping through to synthesis, recommendations, and stakeholder alignment</li> <li>Planning and executing a range of qualitative and quantitative research activities, including usability testing, interviews, surveys, workshops, and behavioural analysis</li> <li>Translating complex research findings into clear, actionable insights that drive product and business decisions</li> <li>Managing multiple research initiatives simultaneously, balancing competing priorities while maintaining quality and momentum</li> <li>Collaborating closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, and Commercial teams to identify research opportunities and answer high-value business questions</li> <li>Communicating research findings confidently and effectively to a range of audiences, from practitioners to senior stakeholders</li> <li>Influencing product strategy through evidence-based recommendations and championing customer needs across the organisation</li> <li>Helping teams navigate ambiguity by identifying research approaches, defining next steps, and bringing clarity to complex problem spaces</li> <li>Supporting the development of research operations, processes, tooling, and best practices</li> <li>Maintaining and contributing to our insights repository to ensure research findings are accessible and reusable</li> <li>Mentoring colleagues and supporting the continued growth of research maturity across the business</li> <li>Building strong relationships with stakeholders to establish effective feedback loops and strengthen the voice of the customer</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years' experience conducting UX Research within digital products or related fields</li> <li>Strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and when to use them</li> <li>Experienced in independently leading complex research projects from start to finish</li> <li>Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and able to bring structure and direction to unclear problem spaces</li> <li>Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messages for different audiences</li> <li>Skilled at synthesising large volumes of information into clear narratives, insights, and recommendations</li> <li>Confident engaging with stakeholders, challenging assumptions constructively, and influencing decision-making</li> <li>Able to prioritise effectively across multiple projects, balancing business goals, customer needs, and team capacity</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent workstreams while maintaining a high standard of delivery</li> <li>Proactive, self-sufficient, and comfortable identifying and resolving blockers independently</li> <li>Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail</li> <li>Curious, analytical, and motivated to understand the "why" behind customer behaviour</li> <li>Passionate about creating user-centred products and embedding customer insight into decision-making</li> </ul> <p>This role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving complex problems, and can confidently drive research forward, even when the path ahead isn't fully defined</p> <p></p> <p> </p> <p></p> <p><strong>Our Offer</strong></p> title: Senior Partnerships Manager: Media & Editorial (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of Position</strong> </p> <p>Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.</p> <p>This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.</p> <p>This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong> </p> <p><strong>Land flagship media partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.</li> <li>Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.</li> <li>Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build the publisher value proposition</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.</li> <li>Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms</li> <li>Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing</li> <li>Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.</li> <li>Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.</li> <li>Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Own the technical and contractual path to live</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.</li> <li>Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.</li> <li>Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Global reach and internal leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.</li> <li>Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.</li> <li>Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.</li> <li>Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.</li> <li>Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success measures (first 12 months)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume</li> <li>A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.</li> <li>A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.</li> <li>Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.</li> <li>Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.</li> <li>Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Key Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.</li> <li>An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.</li> <li>Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.</li> <li>Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.</li> <li>Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.</li> <li>Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.</li> <li>Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.</li> <li>International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.</li> <li>Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.</li> <li>Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.</li> <li>Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.</li> <li>Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.</li> <li>Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.</li> <li>Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.</li> <li>Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.</li> <li>Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.</li> <li>Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.</li> <li>Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.</li> <li>Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.</li> <li>Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.</li> <li>Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.</li> <li>Fluent English essential. German or another European language advantageous.</li> <li>Willingness to travel to relevant markets as required<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p> </p> <div class="TypographyPresentation title: Senior Data Scientist (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>Purpose of the Role</strong></p> <p>Data sits at the heart of the company. This role ensures that Awin can fully leverage the data available across the group, enabling the development of advanced analytical and machine learning capabilities that support stronger commercial decision-making and enhance products used by client-facing teams.</p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist, you will apply advanced statistical techniques, machine learning methods, and analytical approaches to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights that guide business strategy. Working across areas such as forecasting, recommendation systems, network intelligence, experimentation, and predictive modelling, you will lead the design, development, evaluation, and deployment of scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.</p> <p>You will work closely with business stakeholders, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities, shape problem definitions, and translate business challenges into practical technical solutions. You will be responsible for defining success metrics, establishing evaluation frameworks, and ensuring analytical solutions remain reliable, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.</p> <p>In this role, you will lead the development of end-to-end feature pipelines, models, and MVPs, balancing rapid experimentation with long-term sustainability. You will also provide technical leadership to other data scientists, contribute to best practices across the team, and help foster a collaborative, data-driven culture within the organisation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the development and deployment of machine learning, forecasting, recommendation, and analytical solutions that create measurable business impact.</li> <li>Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Engineering, and Data teams to identify opportunities and translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.</li> <li>Design and implement robust evaluation frameworks, experiments, and success metrics to measure performance and business outcomes.</li> <li>Apply statistical modelling, machine learning, and title: Senior Manager, Global Business Development Strategy & Operations
description: <h4><strong>About commercetools</strong></h4> <p>Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.</p> <p>Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.</p> <p>At commercetools, we power the next era of autonomous commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.</p> <p>Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.</p> <h4><strong>Your Impact</strong></h4> <p>As our <strong>Senior Manager, Global BDR Function & Operations</strong>, you will lead and scale our Business Development Representative (BDR) organisation across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), you will serve as a functional leader on the Marketing Leadership Team, driving predictable enterprise pipeline growth by implementing  global outbound motions, standardizing playbooks, and being hands-on with the global BDR team. </p> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the global functional lead for business development, partnering directly with the CMO to align the BDR function with overall demand generation campaigns, brand initiatives, and corporate pipeline targets.</li> <li>Partner with RevOps and Marketing to define, monitor, and optimize global Marketing–BDR SLAs, including funnel velocity, lead scoring models, speed-to-lead benchmarks, and inbound conversion strategies.</li> <li>Own global team metrics against weekly discovery and qualified opportunity targets, providing direct, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.</li> <li>Manage regional BDR teams fostering high-performance leadership standards.</li> <li>Own global team retention strategies, structuring quality-weighted compensation frameworks and clear career pathways.</li> <li>Design, implement, and maintain a single global BDR playbook covering inbound and outbound architecture, multi-channel messaging (email, phone, social), and objection handling.</li> <li>Partner with the People team to support  onboarding and enablement programs globally, incorporating formal certification milestones and structured peer-shadowing.</li> <li>Collaborate with RevOps to optimize tool adoption, AI potential and workflow efficiencies across Salesforce, Clay, Outreach, Gong/Chorus, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and 6sense/intent data platforms.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>This role is in office with five days a week spent in our (Boston MA or London UK) office. </em></strong></p> <h4><strong>What Sets You Apart</strong></h4> <p>You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork.</p> <p>Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work.</p> <p>You bring:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years in B2B SaaS sales development,</li> <li>Proven track record leading distributed BDR/SDR organizations or managing regional team leads/managers across AMER, EMEA, or APAC.</li> <li>Demonstrated success partnering directly with Marketing Leadership (CMO/VPs) to convert marketing demand into qualified enterprise sales opportunities.</li> <li>Hands-on mastery of modern sales tech (Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, intent data, conversation intelligence) and funnel conversion analytics.</li> <li>AI Aptitude<strong>:</strong> A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role.</li> </ul> <p>Nice to Have:<strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in enterprise eCommerce, headless commerce, composable platforms, or digital experience software.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Our Benefits</strong></h4> <p>Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most.</p> <p>🩺 <strong>Comprehensive health benefits</strong> for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support</p> <p>📚 <strong>Learning and development </strong>opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs</p> <p>🍼 <strong>Family Leave Plus</strong> gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition</p> <p><strong>✈️ Family Flex Program:</strong> Remote work for a number of days a year to support family connectivity </p> <p>📈 <strong>Our equity participation program</strong> allows you to share in our success </p> <p>For more information on our benefits, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/our-benefits">visit this page.</a></p> <p><strong>Come as you are. Build with us.</strong></p> <p>Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine.</p> <p>We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. </p> <p>For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, <a href="https://commercetools.com/careers/dei-esg">visit this page</a>. </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Web Designer, Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2><strong>About this role</strong></h2> <p>Our website is one of the most important ways people discover what we offer, understand our value, and decide whether to talk to Sales or start a trial. The Web Growth team owns its roadmap and continuously improves the journey from first impression through to lead capture, demo engagement, signup, and trial start.</p> <p>You’ll treat the website like a product: understand user intent, find confusion and friction, form strong hypotheses, test them with users and data, and turn what you learn into better experiences.</p> <p>You’ll be just as comfortable shaping the problem and influencing the roadmap as you are designing the final interaction, prototype, or page.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Designing and iterating on experiments across landing pages, pricing, signup, and conversion flows to improve engagement, conversion, qualified leads, and trial starts.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Working with Growth, Self-serve, Brand, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to turn opportunities into clear, buildable experiences.</li> <li><strong>Data and insight:</strong> Using user insights and funnel data to identify opportunities, define hypotheses, and measure impact.</li> <li><strong>Product design:</strong> Applying product design thinking to comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, responsiveness, and accessibility.</li> <li><strong>Prototyping and systems:</strong> Prototyping in Figma and code, using AI tools where useful, and working within shared components and brand systems.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap ownership:</strong> Bringing ideas to the Web Growth roadmap, not just executing briefs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must have experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years in web, product, growth, or a closely related design role, with a strong portfolio of shipped, conversion-focused work.</li> <li><strong>Growth mindset:</strong> A track record of using design, growth frameworks, conversion rate optimisation, and funnel analysis to improve outcomes such as leads, conversion, trials, activation, or revenue.</li> <li><strong>Experimentation:</strong> Experience designing and iterating on experiments, including A/B tests or other data-informed approaches. B2B SaaS experience is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Craft and taste:</strong> Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with a sharp eye for typography, hierarchy, detail, and polish.</li> <li><strong>Systems and brand:</strong> Comfortable working within an existing design system and brand, while identifying opportunities to extend and improve it.</li> <li><strong>AI fluency:</strong> Experience using AI in your design practice, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Figma Make, or similar. You should be able to explain how AI has changed your workflow and what you have built or shipped with it.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Able to take a brief and run with it. You work independently, make good decisions, ask the right questions, and bring solutions rather than just options.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who this role is not for</strong></h2> <p>This role is not for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You only want to design campaign or marketing pages from a fixed brief. This role owns the journey from first visit through to lead, demo, signup, or trial.</li> <li>You care about visual polish but not about comprehension, navigation, forms, interactive demos, or reducing friction.</li> <li>You don’t want to work with funnel data, user research, experimentation, or the realities of implementation.</li> <li>You want to focus on brand expression without balancing it with usability, accessibility, performance, and measurable growth.</li> <li>You need a fixed roadmap and detailed requirements rather than identifying opportunities and shaping what the team should test next.</li> <li>You’re not interested in working closely with Growth, Marketing, Product, Data, Research, and Engineering to make the website perform better.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>You’ll know you’re successful if:</p> <ul> <li>More visitors understand Fin and Intercom, find the right path for their needs, and take the next step with less friction.</li> <li>You’ve improved meaningful growth outcomes across qualified leads, demo engagement, signups, and trial starts.</li> <li>Experiments are well designed, clearly measured, and used to inform what the team does next.</li> <li>You’ve made complex product value easier to understand and act on without relying on extra explanation from Sales or Marketing.</li> <li>You’ve built strong working relationships with Growth, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Sales, and Customer Success.</li> <li>You’ve raised the bar for web growth design through thoughtful, high-quality experiences that people trust and want to use.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>We understand that interviewing for a new role is both time- and energy-consuming. We aim to be thorough, speedy, and transparent in our approach.</p> <p>You should expect the entire process to take no more than four weeks from start to finish. You’ll meet with members of our team and have the opportunity to validate that Intercom and the role are the right fit for you.</p> <h2><strong>Ready to build something great?</strong></h2> <p>If you’re excited by the opportunity to help existing businesses get more value from a self-serve product, and you have the craft, curiosity, commercial thinking, and autonomy to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between.
